title: Implement the Matter trigger to personal-assistant review handoff
summary: Add an opt-in versioned wake-up/result boundary around the existing host review entry point, durable retry identity, current controls/access, bounded pointer reads and explicit unknown outcomes. No assistant replacement, trigger threshold or production delivery is supplied.
in_scope: Internal review request and typed review result semantics, with exact source/context/access and outcome provenance.
A bounded single assistant pass using existing host tools, separate from consequential publication or production delivery.

Both immediate decisive-event and accumulated-context route declarations are implemented; the authenticated host selects when to trigger. Numerical scoring, thresholds and decay remain host/owner policy, separate from the versioned review result wire.
KS-1150 host boundary: StateCivics owns the assistant, lens, memory, evidence, reports and review sessions; Matter stores host references plus its own pressure/disposition/baseline/receipt state.
out_of_scope: StateCivics assistant/UI/database/report implementation, host deployment, real-client data processing and production delivery.
New assistant/model client, MCP server, tool wizard, source index, database, queue or general orchestration framework where existing owners supply the capability.
Changing frozen monitoring 1.0/1.1 semantics silently; production alerts, formal qualification, DIAT or unrelated Oil work.
implementation: Inspect MAT-022 investigation, MAT-023 queries, MAT-028 packets, MAT-030 receipts, MAT-072 egress and the existing MAT-082/084 adapters before defining the smallest missing handoff. Locate existing host assistant/wizard entry points with its owner; do not invent an endpoint or service.

Bind a review request to user/workspace/optional-client, approved intent and angle/context versions, continuing matter/material change, authorized citations and availability cut, actual prior communication, why flagged, uncertainty and explicit read/call/time/byte/cost limits. The additive review/ledger 1.0 wire is defined in docs/contracts/assistant-review.md; receiving acceptance remains host work.

Require explicit tool/read/time/byte ceilings and host-managed cost policy. Respect the actual owner-approved study policy, including the host review charge exemption; do not invent a new monetary cap or bypass applicable host grants. Reuse existing investigation/receipt patterns and keep unknown outcomes unresolved instead of blind retry.

Let JEV supply source/change interpretations and let the personal assistant assess current user work and whether to report or interrupt. Avoid repeating the same full analysis; decide what model-derived outputs remain unqualified in capture-only rehearsal.

Retain current access, original tokens and fresh source/context/control checks before and after tool/model work and at any eventual host capture. Direct pause/revoke/edit uses host controls immediately.

Negotiate any new adapter contract explicitly beside frozen 1.0/1.1. Record open choices instead of reinterpreting existing AlertDelivery/capture records as internal work or assuming production permission.

Support two trigger paths under the approved client/objective/angle: a decisive development can immediately wake the assistant even with no prior accumulation (owner example: highly relevant and directly adverse to the client interests); distinct smaller developments can accumulate or become materially significant together when a later event arrives. Both request assistant review, not an automatic human alert.

Retain the owner 24 percent accumulated plus 75 percent new-action illustration without treating the numbers as calibrated JEV probabilities, a fixed additive importance score, or a selected boundary. Define policy meaning and boundary behavior explicitly before implementation; do not reinterpret the existing 1.1 capture-policy decision regions.

A completed assistant review clears the pressure covered by that review regardless of alert/no-alert choice, records versioned ongoing-monitoring adjustments through authorized host controls, and retains all source/finding associations. Failed, unavailable or outcome-unknown review is not completed quiet review.

Treat monitoring adjustments within approved intent and actual delegated host authority as distinct from changing user purpose, client/scope, stance, recipients, permissions or budget ceilings. Preserve existing approval/versioning for those changes; a model recommendation alone grants no authority. The SDK references actual host-approved rule changes and never executes model-directed writes. Host writable fields remain with the host controls; unknown SDK attempts use explicit witnessed reconciliation.

Align with KS-1150: the lens uses existing StateCivics client-or-personal and objective identifiers; review enters the existing inbound path as a distinct matter_review channel, with one logical session chain per lens. Bind host record IDs/digests rather than copying assistant findings, transcripts, reports or memory into Matter. The actual entry takes wake_key=request.wake_id; the SDK wire is versioned separately from host UI/channel implementation.

The final structured review proposal is distinct from the conversational reply. Human-facing output is a host-owned stored report plus rendered alert/notice, using the county meeting report AlertDelivery claim-before-send pattern, not the hearing broadcast ledger. A model reply must never be forwarded as the alert; existing delivery uncertainty and authorization guards remain.

Require explicit per-review tool/time/read/byte ceilings and host lens-session rollover or documented limits. The host owns its existing session caps and study cost/charge policy. This SDK labels host-managed cost policy, grants no extra spend authority and never converts stopped work into quiet.

acceptance.criterion: A trigger can wake review without claiming the user was informed.
acceptance.verification: Write compatibility examples for internal wake-up, reviewed-quiet, report proposed, alert proposed and unavailable/unknown; show separate baseline and outcome receipts. The implemented result vocabulary is specified in the additive review 1.0 contract; software conformance and host receiving acceptance are separate.

acceptance.criterion: Review retains the existing authorization and freshness boundary.
acceptance.verification: Specify refusal checks for foreign client, unapproved intent, revoked source/tool access, changed angle, future evidence and in-flight pause; do not expose contact or unrelated client notes by default.

acceptance.criterion: The first contract slice is bounded and reusable without new infrastructure.
acceptance.verification: Pin real existing assistant/tool entry points and existing Matter APIs; demonstrate a one-pass capture-only example with explicit budget and unknown/recovery semantics. Do not require MAT-040 labels merely to exercise exploratory review.

acceptance.criterion: Both decisive and cumulative developments can request review with an explainable trigger route.
acceptance.verification: Specify cases for immediate review from zero prior pressure, smaller distinct developments below a proposed boundary, a later development making the combination review-worthy, and an event eligible for both routes producing one review request. Fixture thresholds are explicitly illustrative until approved; waking the assistant never fabricates delivery.

acceptance.criterion: Completed review clears pressure independently of alerting while preserving evidence and authorized rule history.
acceptance.verification: Specify alert and no-alert completions, each with a pressure reset scoped to the actually reviewed evidence/context, all evidence links retained and monitoring-change provenance. Show no fabricated human delivery for no-alert, no reset on failed/unknown/stale completion and no loss of material arriving outside the reviewed set.

acceptance.criterion: The host-owned session and report channels are explicit and bounded.
acceptance.verification: Specify bounded session/rollover references, lens isolation, structured proposal and raw-reply suppression, county report claim/outcome references and honest unknowns. Respect actual host/owner decisions without selecting unset thresholds, findings-retention or pilot policy.

tests: Wake-up alone does not advance communicated/captured-for-user knowledge.
A decisive new source correction or deadline can request fresh review despite an earlier quiet/handled decision.
A failed or unavailable review is unknown, not an irrelevance judgment.
A decisive client-adverse development does not wait for accumulation.
One later fact can change the interpretation of earlier quiet findings; do not require keyword counts to reach a universal threshold.
Alert and no-alert review both clear reviewed pressure; neither deletes evidence, resolves the matter automatically or implies the user read the research.
risks: Treating a bubble burst as delivery can fabricate the user baseline.
A universal importance score or unbounded agent loop would recreate complexity before usefulness is shown.

reuse.application: Reuse bounded acquisition, exact evidence inspection and durable attempt semantics.
Reuse source/context guards and preserve frozen capture semantics; this is a separately negotiated assistant port.
